cuesta-rey--centro-fino-sungrown.description: Cuesta-Rey dates to 1884 and the partnership of cigar makers Angel LaMadrid Cuesta and Peregrino Rey. The Centro Fino Sungrown, rolled at Tabacalera A. Fuente, pairs a Sumatra-seed sun-grown wrapper from Ecuador's Quevedo region with a Dominican binder and a Dominican filler that includes aged ligero, for a hearty, rich smoke of medium strength.

cuesta-rey--centenario.description: Centenario is Cuesta-Rey's mild line, rolled at Tabacalera A. Fuente with a Dominican binder and Cuban-seed Dominican filler under either a Connecticut Shade (natural) or Connecticut Broadleaf (maduro) wrapper. Each cigar rests for up to five years in a cedar room, giving a smooth, refined, mild-bodied smoke in six sizes, among them the aluminium-tubed Tuscany.

cuesta-rey--cabinet-selection.description: Cuesta-Rey's Cabinet Selection began in 1958 with the No. 95, which J.C. Newman describes as the first numbered cigar with a genuine African Cameroon wrapper. Rolled at Tabacalera A. Fuente over a Dominican binder and a Dominican and Brazilian filler, the line, completed by the longer No. 898, gives a smooth, medium-bodied smoke.
